flagged.evidence: The proof says, “At an interior point the direction set is the whole connected sphere,” and uses facet adjacency to conclude that all incident polynomial values agree. At a point in the relative interior of an interior facet, the normal link is S^0, which is disconnected, so that argument does not cover the two incident values. The dependency’s conformity definition states that traces agree on every interior facet; that directly supplies the missing equality.
